claims: Apple TV+ is the exclusive home for all Formula 1 live sessions, including practice, qualifying, and Grands Prix, in the United States for the 2026 season.
Yahoo Sports and Mashable note that subscriptions are available for $12.99/month, with 7-day free trials, and select content is free.
Apple TV is the exclusive broadcaster for F1 in the USA for the 2026 season.
Sky Sports and Channel 4 are broadcasters for F1 in the UK for the 2026 season.
F1 TV Pro is available in many regions for live streaming.
F1 TV Pro offers onboard cameras.
F1 TV Pro offers live timing.
BeIN SPORTS is a provider for F1 in Asia.
DAZN is a provider for F1 in Spain.
Viaplay is a provider for F1 in Sweden.
Reports say Apple TV users can access F1 content via Prime Video Channels.
Tom’s Guide has a 57-second YouTube video dated March 2, 2026, that explains how to watch F1 for free and through streaming services.
